AbilityItem_Story_: This pair of earrings was found in a corner of the Forbidden Library. Whoever wears it has the power to identify treasures. Perhaps the owner of the Forbidden Library once relied on it to obtain such an astonishing number of treasures.
AbilityItem_Story_10000: A small, roughly triangular fragment of red gemstone, its surface smooth and hard, emitting a warm red glow.
AbilityItem_Story_10001: A red gem crystal, showing a beautiful hexagonal crystal, emitting a scorching red light.
AbilityItem_Story_10002: A huge red gem, in a perfect oval shape, crystal clear and emitting a flaming red light.
AbilityItem_Story_10010: A fragment of emerald green gemstone, roughly triangular in shape, exuding a refreshing green luster.
AbilityItem_Story_10011: A green gem crystallized into a graceful hexagonal shape, emitting an intense emerald green light.
AbilityItem_Story_10012: A huge green gem, in a perfect oval shape, crystal clear, emitting an intoxicating emerald green light.
AbilityItem_Story_10020: A small piece of blue gem fragment, roughly triangular in shape, emitting a cold blue light.
AbilityItem_Story_10021: A blue gem crystal, showing a beautiful hexagonal crystal, emitting a strong blue light.
AbilityItem_Story_10022: A huge blue gem, in a perfect oval shape, crystal clear and emitting an intoxicating blue light.
AbilityItem_Story_10100: An ordinary glass bottle filled with a light red liquid. The bottle has a simple label and exudes a fresh herbal aroma.
AbilityItem_Story_10101: A delicate glass bottle filled with red liquid. The bottle is engraved with delicate patterns and exudes a rich herbal aroma.
AbilityItem_Story_10102: A gorgeous crystal bottle filled with a deep red liquid, inlaid with delicate silver rims, exudes a captivating herbal aroma.
AbilityItem_Story_10103: A hearty lunch box is full of love and care from your family. If you can open this lunch box and eat it when you are out, it will definitely be several times more delicious and joyful than dry food.
AbilityItem_Story_10104: The exquisitely crafted bird's nest looks like it was made by humans, and the grass used are healthy materials that aid recovery and can be used to make simple medicines.
AbilityItem_Story_10105: This vase is filled with the fountain of life. Flowers placed in it will never wither. However, in such a dangerous place, its true value can only be realized by drinking the fountain water.
AbilityItem_Story_10106: Such pure white bird eggs only appear on the dinner tables of nobles. They symbolize health, purity and longevity, but in fact they taste no different from ordinary eggs.
AbilityItem_Story_10107: A food that only appears in a restaurant would never be taken by adventurers to the dangerous wilderness to be enjoyed, but it would be quite pleasant to taste the delicious cheese at this moment.
AbilityItem_Story_11001: A simple cloth bag of gold coins seemed to be telling thieves to open it quickly and take a look.
AbilityItem_Story_11002: A well-made gold coin bag should have as many gold coins as possible in it.
AbilityItem_Story_11004: Perhaps an accident occurred during the work of a thief who overestimated his own abilities. This coarse cloth bag could only hold one day's food expenses. Sadly, they were quite capable, but they lost the most precious thing for a small profit.
AbilityItem_Story_11005: These are basic tools for alchemists and perfumers to make potions. For them, the more clean and intact tools the better. I believe some grocery stores are also willing to accept them.
AbilityItem_Story_11006: This special commemorative coin was made by the previous king using a gold coin. It is worth one gold coin in itself, but its commemorative value is a full one hundred times greater than its value.
AbilityItem_Story_11101: Magical essence that emits a faint blue glow and is very common in the maze.
AbilityItem_Story_11102: The magic essence that condenses a certain amount of energy can attract many maze creatures.
AbilityItem_Story_11103: The magical essence that gathers enormous energy, only those who explore the maze can understand its meaning.
AbilityItem_Story_11104: A transparent bag contains a docile blue slime. Although it is still defined as a dangerous monster, it is so well-behaved that it will become a pet product that many people are willing to spend a lot of money to buy.
AbilityItem_Story_11105: Parchment made of this material is the best material for recording documents and making magic scrolls, but the parchment itself is not very precious, but the apprentices in the academy are willing to buy some privately.
AbilityItem_Story_11201: A small piece of magic ore can be used to refine a small amount of ore materials as weapon materials.
AbilityItem_Story_11202: Magic ore of moderate size is one of the most important raw materials for forging weapons.
AbilityItem_Story_11203: Magic ore of extremely high purity makes people reluctant to use it to forge weapons.
AbilityItem_Story_12101: A mysterious and powerful magic crystal with the power to reverse life and death.
AbilityItem_Story_13101: An ancient scroll, its surface covered with crude runes, holds a mysterious blessing that can unleash latent power.
AbilityItem_Story_13102: An ancient scroll that hides boundless power. Once the holder releases the mysterious energy contained in the scroll, he or she will gain talents beyond those of ordinary people.
AbilityItem_Story_13103: The Legendary Talent Scroll is like a book of wisdom in the universe. Once obtained, it will grant the user powerful talents, allowing them to reach unprecedented heights in battle and become a legend.
AbilityItem_Story_14101: A mysterious pocket that only appears in the maze, which is supposed to contain some mysterious relics that host the spirit of warriors.
AbilityItem_Story_14102: The mysterious pockets that only appear in the maze must contain mysterious relics that host the powerful spiritual power of the heroes.
AbilityItem_Story_14103: The mysterious pocket only appears in the maze. The value of the relics hidden in it is even difficult to calculate with gold coins. The mysterious relics blessed by legends are waiting to see the light of day.
AbilityItem_Story_14104: A mysterious pocket emanating a curse. These relics, etched with a trial-like curse by the mad obsession of our ancestors, attempt to purify them and restore their sacred form...
AbilityItem_Story_15101: A small gem fell from the holy seal, and it was still shining with the light of protection. If it was set into the holy seal, its light would continue to shine.
AbilityItem_Story_15102: The triangular glass bottle contains two lost holy light elves. The light in the holy seal orb is emitted by these elves. If you place the holy seal next to them, they will become lively and full of faith power for the holy seal.
AbilityItem_Story_15103: Different from ordinary adventurer's holy seal badges, this is a cross that carries the church's holy seal. The difficulty of making it is completely different from that of ordinary holy seal badges, so it also has a stronger blessing.
AbilityItem_Story_20170: The incarnation of the evil god Salvia, he possesses such powerful strength that criminals worship him immensely, but no matter what, they have to get out of prison before they can worship the evil god.
AbilityItem_Story_20171: The champion prize of the Imperial Arena, even though it has powerful magical powers, not many people like to carry this big gem around.
AbilityItem_Story_20172: A pharmacist who was imprisoned by the Empire once invented a strengthening potion. As for whether these well-formulated potions are effective, you have to ask the undead wandering on the battlefield.
AbilityItem_Story_20173: Cute and powerful super boxing gloves! No matter how strong the armor is, it will be vulnerable to them!
AbilityItem_Story_20174: The equipped weapons of the Knights and Squires of the Order. Although they do not need to go to the battlefield, they still need to use this weapon to teach those who intend to cause destruction a lesson that they will never forget.
AbilityItem_Story_20175: In fact, fertilizer can be used not only on farms, as college genius Liliana has proved with this bag of classwork.
AbilityItem_Story_20176: For miners, each time they dig out ore, they will receive more gold coins as rewards. Therefore, in mines where equipment is relatively scarce, iron pickaxes are not the only choice for miners.
AbilityItem_Story_20177: No one can refuse an old and tattered treasure map. After all, it represents his absolute good luck. Therefore, collectors prefer to collect treasure maps rather than the treasure itself.
AbilityItem_Story_20178: A special creature that looks like both a monster and a plant. They like to work in the fields, but when the harvest is about to come, they will rush to plunder all the crops at an absolute speed.
AbilityItem_Story_20179: A princess dropped her high heels while escaping. What kind of princess could escape from the heavily guarded capital?
AbilityItem_Story_20188: The dark blue ashes left after a small bottle of magic flame burns have a sand-like texture and occasionally flashes beautifully like the starry sky. Such sand in a small bottle becomes a very popular decoration and can even make people have a physique that attracts magic.
AbilityItem_Story_20189: Small cards often appear in various adventurer camps and can actually be redeemed. This makes people wonder how this Gem Slime King can travel back and forth so quickly?
AbilityItem_Story_20190: The thorny long sword made of red blood crystals, the more the opponent's injuries accumulate, the closer the user is to victory.
AbilityItem_Story_20191: Like the masks of the priests of the northern mountain country, although they learn magic, it does not affect their ability to charge with sticks.
AbilityItem_Story_20192: A precious treasure of the lizard tribe, only the noble warriors among them are qualified to wear it.
AbilityItem_Story_20193: People say this weapon is a double-edged sword with advantages and disadvantages, but after fighting with it, you will know that it is your best friend at all times.
AbilityItem_Story_20194: The evil spirit that resides in the weapon constantly feeds on the user's lost vitality, while the user tirelessly wields the magic sword until his last bit of strength is exhausted...
AbilityItem_Story_20195: A short knife that is very useful when adventuring in the forest. It is a very suitable helper whether it is making props or collecting herbs.
AbilityItem_Story_20196: The spear that houses the soul of the red dragon will only give its power to a powerful warrior. The true power of this spear responds to the user as he grows.
AbilityItem_Story_20197: A centuries-old underwater dynasty once produced these swords in large quantities, and they are now a favorite treasure among fishermen.
AbilityItem_Story_20198: A part of the core of the maze, possessing the power to control some of the maze's rules. This destructive power will follow its holder to achieve his goals...
AbilityItem_Story_20199: This noble statue symbolizes health. I don’t know if it is useful, but it’s always good to have it with you.
AbilityItem_Story_20200: A legendary adventurer concluded her last adventure and handed this walking stick to a destined person. Then she walked into the sunset. No one knew where she ended up, and she didn't even take her luggage with her...
AbilityItem_Story_20210: The blood demon that parasitizes on the sickle can provide the user with powerful strength, but the user only needs to pay a small price.
AbilityItem_Story_20211: The sword of the Demon King of the Flame Realm. There is no doubt that a demon as powerful as him will become stronger after suffering excessive damage, right?
AbilityItem_Story_20212: The best offense is the best defense!
AbilityItem_Story_20220: An ancient creature born from flames, the scorching flames continue to burn on the elf's body, and the heat it emits is its fighting spirit. It is ready to burn all the enemies to ashes.
AbilityItem_Story_20221: Lava Dancer is a fire elemental spirit, draped in a red robe that flows like lava, dancing lightly through the air. Her eyes are a deep, fiery crimson, radiating wisdom and mystery. Lava Dancer's body is composed of flames and scorching magma, as if a fusion of life force and the element of fire.
AbilityItem_Story_20222: Explosive Sirbal is a fervent fire spirit, her very presence akin to a blazing flame. Tall and graceful, her entire form is encircled by dancing flames, emitting a dazzling orange-red glow. Her eyes, blazing like blazing fire, are filled with fighting determination and unbridled enthusiasm.
AbilityItem_Story_20230: Mysterious life forms born from the waters. They are slender, with crystal-clear skin that emits a faint vapor. A halo, resembling a droplet of water, shimmers above their heads. Water sprites often dance with fluid movements, as free as flowing water.
AbilityItem_Story_20231: A mysterious and ancient presence dwells within the waters. Like ripples on the surface, they dance gently in the wind, emitting a soft glow. Formed from the crystal-clear waters and gentle breezes, these spirits possess translucent bodies, a fusion of water and light.
AbilityItem_Story_20232: A powerful incarnation of the god of the sea. His stature is as majestic as a surging wave, and he exudes the aura of water. Poseidon holds a trident, symbolizing his dominion over the sea and his power over the waters.
AbilityItem_Story_20240: Wind elves are as graceful as the wind, their bodies transparent, as if condensed from the erratic breeze. They often play in the wind, floating in the air like a group of dancing wind elves.
AbilityItem_Story_20241: A manifestation of the power of wind, a mysterious and powerful being. Its form is ethereal and fleeting, like a dark shadow in a storm, imbued with a strong element of wind. The appearance of a Gale Shadow is often accompanied by howling winds and shifting skies.
AbilityItem_Story_20242: The goddess of storms, clad in robes of wind and clouds, exudes the powerful force of wind. Atop her head rests the Storm Crown, and every step seems to unleash a roar of thunder. Hurricane Freya's eyes are deep and mysterious, like the lightning in a storm.
AbilityItem_Story_20250: These natural spirits are closely associated with the element of thunder and lightning. Their bodies are sleek and shimmering with lightning, resembling a streak of flowing lightning. Thunder sprites are often active during thunderstorms, swirling through the clouds and emitting breathtaking, electric beauty.
AbilityItem_Story_20251: Leading the charge are the lightning-dazzling Thunder Elves, who dance amidst clouds crisscrossed with thunder and lightning, each movement a powerful arc of electricity. Their steps, like musical notes, compose a song of thunder and lightning, bringing a stunning and beautiful performance to the land.
AbilityItem_Story_20252: A thunder god who controls violent lightning. He stands tall and mighty, wearing a thunder crown, his eyes radiating lightning. His skin seems woven from thunderclouds and arcs of lightning, and his entire body radiates an intense force of thunder and lightning.
AbilityItem_Story_20260: A mysterious creature imbued with pure, luminous energy. Elegant and radiant, they resemble miniature spirits of light. Light elves are often closely associated with the power of light and goodness.
AbilityItem_Story_20261: Mysterious beings in the night sky, clad in robes of stars, radiate a light like the twinkling stars. Astral spirits are light and ethereal, as if they were cosmic spirits descending from the starry sky.
AbilityItem_Story_20262: A glorious goddess, her image is noble and radiant, like the rising sun at dawn. Hera is clad in a flowing robe of light, a crown on her head, and holds a scepter filled with divine light.
AbilityItem_Story_21111: Troll equipment collected from the Adventurer's Guild indicates that this type of troll does not move in groups and has lost the regenerative ability of ordinary species.
AbilityItem_Story_21112: Due to the frequent occurrence of various troll disasters, the Adventurer's Guild officially classified this type of trolls as "elite" level and launched a targeted crusade. The materials looted after the war were even more powerful than the best materials in the town.
AbilityItem_Story_21113: A crudely made club is the weapon that truly suits the trolls. When the trolls lose the guidance of the evil man, they will eventually return to their most primitive state of life. Only then will the trolls' disaster officially end.
AbilityItem_Story_21114: A strange ritual dagger, engraved with mysterious words, seemed to be constantly emitting a cursed aura, attracting nearby monsters and strengthening them. From the small part of the purification, one could sense the once abundant magical power of this ritual dagger...
AbilityItem_Story_21121: The ritual dagger shed its evil curse, revealing the pattern of the ancient Holy Kingdom. It was now absorbing the lost magical power from all around. Simply swiping the dagger in the air could emit a magical fluorescence that illuminated the world.
AbilityItem_Story_21122: A tragedy occurred at the Grand Theatre in the Principality of Star when an actor playing a criminal was poisoned on stage, forcing the performance to be terminated. An investigation failed to discover the source of the poison, but no one suspected the terrifying mask that could not be removed...
AbilityItem_Story_21123: After recovering from his illness, he once again took to the stage and brought countless wonderful performances to everyone. Even though he was exhausted physically and mentally, he had to do this. He had to feel everyone's cheers in order to temporarily get rid of this terrible mask...
AbilityItem_Story_21124: A rare flower that withers before it blooms. Such wild flowers grow in large numbers deep in an extremely dangerous maze. It is precisely because of this low profile that people find it difficult to realize that their energy has long been absorbed by the maze to strengthen the monsters and curses in the maze.
AbilityItem_Story_21131: A strange flower in the maze that is about to bloom has avoided the maze's drain of its life force. It has finally begun to thrive and hide in its own life domain to avoid new disasters.
AbilityItem_Story_21132: The Empire's black-hearted merchant king forged commercial gold coins with inferior materials, and those merchants spent their lives with these dark gold coins that they could not consume, and attributed all their resentment to this dark gold coin. From then on, the curse of the dark gold coin began to spread, and even infected normal gold coin pockets, causing them to begin to depreciate.
AbilityItem_Story_21133: After the curse of the Dark Gold Coins lifted, these antique coins, with a little polishing, became incredibly ornate and valuable collectors' items over time. Many merchants were willing to pay large sums of money to acquire these antique coins for their collections. I wonder if this outcome is any comfort to the merchants who were once victims of this...
AbilityItem_Story_21134: As one of the most ancient races after the primitive elves, the Crystal Ancient Dragons are extremely expensive enhancement materials and adventure materials for adventurers. However, how could these ancient primates sit idly by and wait for death in the "Empire Dragon Hunting Operation"? They will cover their entire bodies with curses and launch a counterattack against the Empire. Even if they lose their lives, they will not give up their dignity and become a relic to be used.
AbilityItem_Story_21141: Even as a relic, the dragon scale armor still retains a portion of the crystal dragon's consciousness. Upon receiving the ancient dragon's approval, the filth covering the armor instantly fades, revealing the beautiful and sturdy crystal dragon scales that will bless and protect the bearer as they complete their unfinished adventure...
AbilityItem_Story_21142: A mysterious feather from a calamity beast will bring bad luck to anyone who picks it up. Even so, countless nobles still desire such a mysterious feather. They wear it on their bodies like a symbol of status, have painters record their portraits, and then destroy the feather.
AbilityItem_Story_21143: After the disaster monster passes through the manic period, its feathers will become smooth and shiny, and its personality will become gentle and lovely. It will also place its blessings on the feathers and give them to kind people it meets by chance.
AbilityItem_Story_21144: The warriors of the Empire fought one fatal battle after another in the arena, just to win a few gold coins to drink heartily in the evening, and to tell others about their heroic battles and win a night of glory. However, along with the glory, they also gained a series of irreparable sword scars...
AbilityItem_Story_21151: The strongest warriors in the Imperial Arena always take a swig before entering the arena. In a duel, no matter how chaotic the fight, the last one standing wins. This is especially true for the "champion." What's the secret to victory? They always say—perseverance.
AbilityItem_Story_21152: When you go to a poor village, the villagers will still enthusiastically take out the best food for you to have a full meal, and then tell you that there is a powerful monster threatening the village that needs you to defeat it. Although this commission process is quite déjà vu, it is very difficult to refuse, even if the food they take out is stale bread.
AbilityItem_Story_21153: When the monsters threatening the village are eliminated, the village will naturally prosper. When you return, they will naturally treat you warmly, and the food this time looks very delicious. Although it is just a piece of bread, it is already quite an improvement.
AbilityItem_Story_21154: The cursed wand of Duchess Mira of the Principality. She had been fighting against an old enemy for many years. In order to defeat him, Duchess Mira even invited a shaman to curse her most precious scepter. After a great war, Duke Mira's mansion lost its owner and was gradually abandoned, but this strange scepter that constantly summoned thunder was still left on the battlefield.
AbilityItem_Story_21161: The original appearance of Duchess Mira's scepter can continuously summon thunder to attack anyone who tries to approach her, but this alone cannot win the duel. As a last resort, she must curse the scepter so that even if she cannot win, it cannot be taken away by others.
AbilityItem_Story_21162: A certain tribe of lizardmen stumbled upon this mysterious stone tablet. As if possessed, they stopped their usual hunting and instead gathered around it, quietly listening to whispers from another world...
AbilityItem_Story_21163: After the lizardman tribe was abandoned, the stone tablet was taken away by other tribes. But the difference was that this new tribe was not affected by the strange influence of the stone tablet. Instead, they worked more diligently, which led to the emergence of legendary monsters such as the Lizard King.
AbilityItem_Story_21164: For the crumbling royal family of the Holy Kingdom, the crown is the only remaining symbol. The closer the kingdom's cavalry gets, the more uneasy they become. Even though the corrupt aura of the crown has begun to erode everything, they still carry it on their bodies, waiting for the day when the corruption will fade away.
AbilityItem_Story_21171: After the kingdom's nobles seized the crown, the corruption of the crown began to fade until it became what it is today. They placed the crown in the center of the tower and spread the powerful blessing of the crown itself to demonstrate the kingdom's nobles' own tolerance and strength.
AbilityItem_Story_21172: Another mysterious relic within the Forbidden Library, the Holy Empire has long used its power to impersonate the divine power of Goddess Tina, judging others. This behavior has sparked widespread discontent. With this relic in existence, neutrality itself is a sin...
AbilityItem_Story_21173: When the unfair scales were broken, someone secretly took the fragments home to repair them. He felt unprecedentedly lucky, as if all the good luck was biased towards him.
AbilityItem_Story_21174: The wild mushrooms in the maze are absolutely inedible, but these plants can easily become a habitat for micro-spirits and blessings. Carrying a piece of mushroom on you will obviously increase your affinity with blessings. Of course, curses will also be attracted to you...
AbilityItem_Story_22011: The strange gauntlets exuded a strange aura. Wearing them didn't feel anything special, but from time to time, I'd find myself in a void, and then my body would begin to transform into magic and gradually dissipate. Was it just a nightmare? Or perhaps I had truly come into contact with the magical power of the void?
AbilityItem_Story_22012: The wine glass of the Witch of Disaster reflects all the wealth of this country. All the property belongs to this powerful witch. When people have to pay fifty times the price for a piece of bread, the seeds of resistance have been sown.
AbilityItem_Story_22021: After the first princess of the Holy Kingdom defeated the Witch of Disaster, she threw the wine cup outside the palace and announced that a new era was about to begin.
AbilityItem_Story_22022: Of course monsters need to eat meat to grow, right?
AbilityItem_Story_22031: The experimental waste left over by the witches sometimes makes the monsters in an area extremely powerful. Why is this?
AbilityItem_Story_22032: The alchemists' most precious creation, it can invigorate even weary creatures! Despite its poor taste, it's still a favorite of many farmers.
AbilityItem_Story_22041: It is said to be the magical substance that all monsters are composed of. Monsters will devour each other's original substance to obtain their intelligence and power.
AbilityItem_Story_22042: The shining and powerful elf feathers will make even the most ferocious monsters stop and admire them.
AbilityItem_Story_22051: For some monsters, it is their favorite treasure!
AbilityItem_Story_23024: A mysterious group of pagans have held this otherworldly blade for centuries, formed from the magical energy of the air. Its strange form and power evoke the void of the Holy Kingdom's dungeon...
AbilityItem_Story_23030: The twinkling stars in this otherworldly world take on the form of the heart of life. You follow the whispers of the void, searching for it, but you'll find yourself unable to get even a fraction closer...
AbilityItem_Story_23031: The twinkling stars in this otherworldly world take on the shape of musical instruments, a gigantic constellation that constantly follows the invaders through the void, occasionally playing mysterious music in the sky...
AbilityItem_Story_23032: The twinkling starlight in this otherworld takes on the form of a vessel, quietly gleaming and embellishing the otherworldly sky. Carefully sketching its image reveals a connection to the wishing bottles of the terrestrial world...
AbilityItem_Story_23033: The masterpiece of the craftsmen in the royal city combines hand armor with light elves, allowing warriors who are not good at long-range combat to have the means of long-range combat. Unfortunately, due to the complexity of the craftsmanship, it is destined to be very valuable.
AbilityItem_Story_23040: Forge precious ores into the shape of orbs, creating shining orbs that are more suitable for light elves to inhabit, so that they can burst out with enough power to penetrate boulders in battle.
AbilityItem_Story_23041: With the help of the slime, the light elf was able to break through the limit of its power. At this moment, the light elf could store more power in the gauntlet, allowing the user to burst out double power at critical moments.
AbilityItem_Story_23042: It allows the user to no longer rely on the light elves in the gauntlet, but to store the power of the light elves and distribute it reasonably according to their own combat style.
AbilityItem_Story_23043: A paladin died defending the royal city. His blood and will were forged into a rune, allowing the wearer to exchange his life for vitality.
AbilityItem_Story_23050: When the Paladin fell, the gods heard his final cry and transformed his will into an echoing sound, which turned into an invisible barrier to protect his successors from desperate situations.
AbilityItem_Story_23051: When the Paladin fell, the blacksmith poured the remaining blood and fire into the forge, forging armor imbued with the power of the rune of sacrifice. Whenever the rune bleeds on the chest, afterglow bursts from the seams of armor, reflecting the bond between the living and the dead.
AbilityItem_Story_23052: Ancient prophecies record that anyone who touches the Paladin's blood pact will be bound by the shackles of fate. With their blood stained by the symbol of sacrifice, their pain is frozen on the brink of life and death, and the final blow is also inevitable.
AbilityItem_Story_23053: The legendary mysterious key that opens the gate to another world in the ruins of the Holy Kingdom can add fantastic power to other weapons.
AbilityItem_Story_25001: A promotional product launched by a certain chamber of commerce, with a little light elf and rebates, can capture the hearts of most people.
AbilityItem_Story_25002: Every time the bomb's fuse is lit, time passes very slowly...
AbilityItem_Story_25003: The little devil's magical wings may not look very delicious, but they are a rare snack for those monsters hunting in the sky.
AbilityItem_Story_25004: Liliana, a genius girl from the academy, cooked a nutritious meal specially for monsters, although not many monsters liked it.
AbilityItem_Story_25005: The dark sword collected in the Forbidden Library does not have any extraordinary magical effects on the sword itself, but the holder can vaguely feel that the true power of this weapon is connected with a familiar partner.
AbilityItem_Story_25006: The wand used by the evil dragon wizard Kun, the number one villain in the Empire's Dragon Hunt. Who would have thought that this wand itself is the incarnation of the dark dragon?
AbilityItem_Story_25007: A spear crafted from the power of a demon was purchased at an auction and buried by a mysterious individual. Rumors abound as to its location and reason for burial.

You ate the <color=#84ee6f>green</color> part of the apple and suddenly felt dizzy! After recovering, you felt even stronger!

You can sense that the town's construction has been the product of generations of painstaking effort. Upon closer inspection, you discover nothing is left but a fragment of a relic that seems out of place in its surroundings. Picking it up, you discover the town behind you has vanished, and the relic has lost its power. Fortunately, the relic itself is <color=#FFFF00>valuable</color>.

The greedy Red chose this gorgeous golden sword.
Unexpectedly, the Water Spirit actually gave him the Golden Sword.
However, in the ensuing battle, the Golden Sword had been damaged in various ways and was unusable...

The Careless Knight actually forgot whether he was carrying the Silver Sword, designed to fight demons.
However, he chose the Silver Sword anyway.
The Water Spirit gave him the Silver Sword. Unexpectedly... the monsters feared the knight wielding the Silver Sword, so they didn't encounter any more battles during this exploration.
This was unacceptable to Red, who yearned for power, so he decided to sell it to the Maze Gem Slime King and continue his adventure.

<color=#ED8620>Red</color> had never seen a <color=#C18C3C>copper sword</color> before, so when he took the <color=#C18C3C>copper sword</color> from the <color=#0786E7>Water Elf</color>, he couldn't let it go. Perhaps now he had truly obtained his own weapon.

This is how a normal person would react! Who would want to be associated with such a <color=#d2b1ff>weird place</color>? You try to ignore the strange noises, and as you walk through town and breathe a sigh of relief, you notice that your <color=#FFFF00>wallet</color</color> seems to have inexplicably gotten a bit richer...
Unlike ordinary life potions, this one has a sour and refreshing fragrance, and is even somewhat delicious?
This bottle of life potion contains a large amount of raspberries, which seems to be not for treatment but for appetizing?
It seems like it's my illusion, I actually feel like the more I drink this potion, the more it makes?

If you think about it carefully, this is actually a very reasonable deal. When you ask why there are no sapphires, they just say that they have broken many pickaxes but could not get a small piece of sapphire.

You rejected the opportunity to buy gems, but think about it, it's not a loss. As an adventurer, you can use your own strength to obtain better gems, right?
A mysterious cloth bag will never disappoint you. Maybe it contains treasures that are more valuable than ore, right?
As a miner, of course you have to choose the ore! Making money is the most important thing!
Digging out rocks is the worst option, and for miners, time is money. While you are still pondering the truth, the miner has already dug out the rocks and placed them next to you.
You decide to take the magic essence for yourself! This step is difficult, but you promise to conquer the maze with the owner's effort!

As expected of a noble adventurer, but after waiting for so long, the owner still hasn't arrived.
Is there a possibility? Is this magical essence originally generated here? Although I wasted some time, I also grew a little.

As you stepped onto the stage, you could sense the opponent's immense aura, emanating a power no less powerful than that of a maze lord! Before you could react, she came over to you and knocked you off the stage with one punch. Although you were defeated, she was still willing to share the championship prize with you, allowing you to take away a random relic from the bag.

This mage looks like he's not someone you can easily mess with. You have a feeling it's best to leave quickly...
But what I didn't expect was that even with this, there are still rewards for participating?!

You happily tossed a <color=#FFFF00>gold coin</color>, which landed precisely in the hat in front of the old man. You gave him a gesture of appreciation. Before leaving, the old man gave you a <color=#70a6ff>package</color> as a souvenir of this story.

When you were satisfied and ready to leave, the sound of the harp rang out again. You really couldn't refuse the following story. After a long story ended, you struggled to get up and found that the old man had left, leaving only a <color=#70a6ff>package</color</color> for you to keep as a souvenir.

You accepted the blind box, and when you were about to rate his service, you found that the salesperson had disappeared without a trace. Such skill makes you sigh, maybe he has never given a bad review...
You choose to purchase this unidentified membership package. The salesperson immediately prepares a membership gift for you, then disappears into a nearby wall, perhaps to find the next customer.
You gave him a meaningful look and turned away, leaving him standing there alone, feeling the indifference of the world.

You handed over <color=#888eff>100 Mana Essence</color> and opened the secret. Written on it were four words, quite sensibly, "Work hard!" You looked up in anger, only to find a <color=#70a6ff>cloth bag</color</color> lying on the ground, having hastily dropped it.
You are good at restraining your inner desires, holding your purse tightly as you walk away. Even if the fortune teller looks at you pitifully, you won't look back!
You left behind a simple blueprint, and even though you couldn't understand it, the monsters still gave you a <color=#70a6ff>gift</color> to express their gratitude.
Apparently, some scraps can become your...<color=#888eff>source of income</color>?!

You pick up your tools and harvest all the ripe wheat. Suddenly, a scarecrow leaps out and attacks you! After a brief clash, it finally collapses from exhaustion. Perhaps it's more accurate to say that the relic within it can no longer sustain it.
You carefully walked through the wheat field. For some reason, you always felt that <color=#d2b1ff>something was watching you</color>.

He put your equipment together with other materials, and you found that the equipment looked brand new! When you wanted to ask him, he had already made the wood into a fully equipped workbench, dug up the dirt on the ground and jumped down.

He arranged some materials neatly, then miraculously obtained a [Obtained <color=#70a6ff>Mysterious Item</color>] and handed it to you. When you wanted to thank him, he had already made the wood into a fully equipped workbench, dug up the dirt on the ground, and jumped down.
You open the bottle cap, listen to the pleasant sound of bubbles, and drink the drink <color=#ADD8E6>in one gulp</color>!
You've keenly spotted the commercial potential of this bottle of soda, so it's best to sell it! Even if you don't know how it grows.
You ask the old man for more combat techniques, and he hands you a mysterious relic and says, "There's nothing more I can teach you." Then, he walks away.

You listened to the teachings and felt you had learned something, becoming stronger. When you looked back at the old man, he had already slowly walked away and said, "I have nothing more to teach you."

AdvantureEventData_StoryText_1: You thought seeing a <color=#ADD8E6>deserted</color> town in the maze was eerie enough, but now you can actually hear the <color=#ADD8E6>sounds of everyday life</color> inside the node! Apparently, this town harbors some terrifying <color=#d2b1ff>phantom monster</color>! Thinking about it another way, there must be some <color=#FFFF00>treasure</color> worth finding, right?
AdvantureEventData_StoryText_10: At an adventurer's resting place, you found an old lady dressed strangely. She had a strange laugh and handed you an apple with two different colors.
AdvantureEventData_StoryText_11:
After defeating an ambush by a monster, the careless knight Red passed by a river, but due to a sudden shift in the maze, he lost his balance and fell into the water.
When he climbed back onto the shore, he discovered that his weapon was missing!
As Red pondered what to do next, a elf suddenly appeared from the water and asked him...
Warrior... Did you lose this gold sword? Or the silver sword? Or the bronze sword?
AdvantureEventData_StoryText_12: A young pharmacist recommends his newly made <color=#E93B3B>panacea!</color> Don't worry, it shouldn't cause any problems.
AdvantureEventData_StoryText_13:
In the maze world, large gems are indeed extremely valuable, but for many adventurers, collecting large gems is too difficult, and they don't need such high rewards. So they will knock off smaller gems, add their own craftsmanship, and sell them to passing travelers or adventurers.
So... do you need a portion?
AdvantureEventData_StoryText_14: An old man was fiddling with a magic tool that seemed to be able to easily drill into the ground and dig for treasure. In that case, how about asking him to help dig up something I could use?
AdvantureEventData_StoryText_15:
On your adventure, you found a large amount of magic essence on the ground!
What should you do? The owner must be very anxious! But even more anxious... is you, because the maze world is a jungle where the strong prey on the weak, and this magic essence is always tempting you to take it for yourself! What should you do?
AdvantureEventData_StoryText_16: There's a fighting arena somewhere in the maze, and the area is bustling with activity. It turns out a wizard is holding a fighting tournament, with a mysterious relic as the prize! Want to try it out?
AdvantureEventData_StoryText_2: An old man in funny clothes sat nearby, playing the harp and telling fairy tales. Before you knew it, you'd listened to the entire story and even found it unexpectedly wonderful! You couldn't help but want to give a tip!
AdvantureEventData_StoryText_3: A <color=#ADD8E6>salesman</color> suddenly appeared from an inconspicuous corner. No one knew how he got here. After a quick tidy up, he started selling you the maze support service, assuring you that it was absolutely <color=#FFFF00>worth the money</color>.
AdvantureEventData_StoryText_4: A mysteriously dressed <color=#ADD8E6>fortune teller</color> suddenly calls you over. She says she's been waiting for you for a long time and has prepared a secret to quickly <color=#FFFF00>getting rich</color>. All it requires is <color=#888eff>100 magic essence</color>!
AdvantureEventData_StoryText_5: You see a group of buildings that...at least look like a village. Your rich adventure experience tells you that these are monsters of a certain race imitating this kind of construction method.
AdvantureEventData_StoryText_6: Looking at the scene before you, you try to convince yourself that a wheat field could appear in a wasteland without a village, right?
AdvantureEventData_StoryText_7: You see an <color=#ADD8E6>adventurer</color> crafting something out of wood with his bare hands. Would you like to ask him to help repair some equipment?
AdvantureEventData_StoryText_8: Incredible! You found a bottle of <color=#ADD8E6>soda growing out of the ground</color>! It looks so sweet and delicious, would you like one?
AdvantureEventData_StoryText_9: While you were training, an old man stood behind you and commented: "Calmness is the key to fighting!"

EnemyData_Description_11003: A frog monster often found in wetlands, it's larger than other frogs and possesses a certain affinity for water magic. Its tongue-fired water bullets can instantly destroy a wooden shield, making it a rare target for novice adventurers. An adventurer once attempted to complete a subjugation commission by poisoning it, but nothing happened for several days after it devoured the bait. The accompanying scholar excitedly recorded a research report on the frog's high resistance to poison, but the adventurer, who had paid for the poison and its living expenses, was less pleased...

They choose to burrow into the soil to survive. While not brave, at least they can save their lives, right?
Rather than being extremely aggressive, it's more likely that they are overly sensitive to magic. These adventurers, possessing magical combat skills, are clearly more "attractive" than the tall trees on the roadside.

EnemyData_Description_13001: The powerful lord guarding the forest maze is the undisputed "alpha" of the wolf monsters. Outside the maze, rumors of the Scarlet Flame Wolf King have spread. He guards a vast forest and represents the wolf race. If an adventurer attempts to subjugate a wolf in this forest, he will arrive amidst the full moon and the howling of wolves. In a duel, he will teach the adventurer the price he will pay, leaving a mark of his fire magic on the field. Generally, the Adventurer's Guild doesn't post requests to subjugate the Scarlet Flame Wolf King on the bulletin board. After all, the Scarlet Flame Wolf King poses a threat comparable to that of the dragons that inhabit the mountains, requiring a truly powerful hero to stand a chance against him.
EnemyData_Description_21001: A dragon lizard warrior patrolling the desert wields a severely damaged dagger. The condition of the dagger suggests they lack the skill to craft weapons, let alone repair them. All of the dragon lizard warriors' equipment likely comes from damaged equipment discarded by adventurers.
EnemyData_Description_21002: The dragon lizard archers standing guard throughout the desert wield sturdy ranger hunting bows. Judging from their shooting skills, they must have undergone considerable training, at least when it comes to target shooting, they are quite skilled.
EnemyData_Description_21003:
The snake monsters that roam the desert differ from other snakes in that they appear to float in mid-air, proudly displaying their forms.
A scholar of Liliana's class is diligently researching the secrets of the flying snakes' levitation. He believes the secret lies in the constantly swirling desert sands, and that the snakes use their bodies to crawl through the swirling dust, creating the illusion of levitation. This is already the fourth paper he's failed...
EnemyData_Description_21004: Plant monsters, emerging from the sand, rely on absorbing residual magic from the sand to grow, storing most of this magic within their bodies to withstand greater environmental crises. Cacti remain mostly silent, conserving nutrients as much as possible. If an intruder attempts to harm them for their own gain, they will retaliate with all their might.
EnemyData_Description_21005: Young earth dragons, living on land for years, gradually lose the ability to fly, but they still possess the defining characteristic of a dragon: their breath, which resembles a fireball. Even though they can no longer fly, they still protect their wings. After all, those tiny wings can be very useful in crucial moments of battle.
EnemyData_Description_22001: Giant sandworms lurk beneath the quicksand. Quicksand is their ultimate weapon, placing anything within its reach within their reach. Quicksand worms have no fixed habitat; they frequently migrate, attacking intruders. Therefore, trading in the desert is a bad idea. Caravans often spend large sums of gold on hired guards and risk losing significant merchandise in the event of a surprise attack.
EnemyData_Description_22002: A strange monster born from quicksand, it serves as both a companion and a weapon. A Quicksand Devourer constantly absorbs quicksand to protect itself, but it also gathers it and sprays it at its enemies. Due to its physical properties, weapons are unable to effectively kill this monster, making it one of warriors' greatest troubles.
EnemyData_Description_22003: One of the oldest monsters in the mines, thousands of years of surviving challenges have endowed them with exceptional combat prowess. Constantly absorbing the magical energy emanating from the magic ore has given them energy levels comparable to those of magic apprentices. To adapt to the mine's harsh environment, they gnaw on rocks for nutrition, absorb magic ore to enhance their strength, and successfully evolve. Monster evolution requires luck, and the Crystal Scorpion has no shortage of it.
EnemyData_Description_23001: The powerful lord guarding the desert is the kingdom's centuries-old guardian beast. The Griffin is an ancient sacred beast of the kingdom. Legend has it that in times of danger for the royal city, the beast descends from the sky and uses powerful wind magic to drive the enemy from the land. The beast's arrival often brings a powerful hurricane, a warning to invaders and a clarion call for the kingdom's army to strike back. While dust storms are common in the desert, the constant sandstorms within the labyrinth are perhaps the work of the Griffin. However, what caused it to abandon the mountains, where wind magic is most abundant, and choose to inhabit such a harsh environment remains unknown.
EnemyData_Description_23002: A powerful lord guarding the mines, a magical golem from an unknown era, possesses the power to destroy mountains once activated. Magic golems are frequently used in wars. These golems are powerful, loyal, brave, and incapable of fear. Their thirst for victory has led to rapid advancements in magic golem technology, culminating in the creation of a Titan that can easily destroy a castle. With the war's end, the golems were abandoned, gradually blending seamlessly into their surroundings, becoming part of the historical relic. However, the "core" that powered the Titan remains healthy. Rather than abandoned, it awaits the next war, the next battlefield...
EnemyData_Description_31001: Ordinary monsters living in the snowy plains use the bony spurs on their heads to hunt weaker prey for nutrition. In an environment like the snowy plains, the Skeleton Tortoise added an exoskeleton to its shell, further enhancing its defenses. This evolution was crucial, allowing it to transition from being prey to hunters of weaker monsters. After all, no monster enjoys chewing on a rock.
EnemyData_Description_31002: Normal monsters born from snowballs are extremely stealthy in the snowy plains. They generally transform back into snowballs when threatened, but a few remain aggressive. While Frost Monsters lack exceptional combat power, they possess a powerful magical affinity after transforming back into snowballs, attracting surrounding ice and snow to charge at enemies. Even the most adorable Frost Monsters won't want to be hit by this.
EnemyData_Description_31003: Walrus warriors, armed with large shields of solid ice, wield them with their brute strength. Walrus warriors often appear in frozen ruins. As the ice melts, they follow the ruins into the future, but they never forget their mission to guard the ruins. They forge shields from the solid ice and continue to fulfill their duty.
EnemyData_Description_31004:
Walrus warriors armed with ice spears fight by throwing or stabbing their enemies.
Walrus warriors armed with spears do not exist to guard the frozen ruins. They are excellent soldiers of the ruins' masters, serving as vanguards to expand the territory for the ruins' forces.
EnemyData_Description_31005: Capable of channeling ice and snow magic, these ice monsters require no food and possess only the most rudimentary intelligence, attacking any uninvited visitors who venture into the snow with all their might. Theoretically, ice monsters possess a strong affinity for magic, but for some reason, adventurers have only seen them fight by wielding sharp ice crystals.
EnemyData_Description_32001: The giant sky dragons that inhabit the snowy mountains, though still in their infancy, are already strong enough to independently hunt for prey in the wild. The dragons' greed never fades, and whenever they get the chance, they'll swarm and raid nearby castles, plundering treasures.
EnemyData_Description_32002: Capable of mid-air flight, these ice rays may have once lived beneath frozen rivers, but it seems the loss of their former home hasn't had any significant impact on them. After leaving the rivers, they quickly adapted to the snowy environment, integrating it with the currents to become a terrifying creature on the glaciers.
EnemyData_Description_33001: The powerful lord guarding the snowfields is a formidable beast depicted on the walls of the icy ruins outside the labyrinth. The Phantom Deer King isn't some mysterious beast; any ruin associated with ice and snow will inevitably feature murals and depictions of it. Some formidable adventurers have even battled its phantoms within the ruins' treasure chambers, only to be surrounded by them one after another, forcing them to retreat. Even outside the labyrinth, no one knows the origins of these Phantom Deer King phantoms, let alone their true strength. All they know is that they are one with the ice and snow, and even if they temporarily triumph, they will return time and again.
EnemyData_Description_41001: The monsters that haunt the mines typically conceal themselves, pretending to be ore, waiting for their prey to take the bait and attack them. While this ore disguise is their most common tactic, they still have a significant advantage even in direct combat. Their carapaces are the perfect form of armor, making it easy for them to summon ore to attack enemies in the mines.
EnemyData_Description_41002: A common monster lurking in mines, the Poison Exploder typically appears in areas devoid of fluorescent minerals, where their glow attracts prey. The Poison Exploder stores surrounding mineral dust within its body, activating it upon encountering a threat, causing it to explode. While its combat effectiveness is limited, it can be extremely effective if it launches a surprise attack on unsuspecting adventurers.
EnemyData_Description_41003: They looked like uninvited visitors from outside the maze, or perhaps a joke played by the maze's memories on the adventurers. One thing was certain: these ghost mages were not creatures meant to live in the mines. Ghost mages only wield low-level dark magic and possessed little combat power. They were often seen at altars or in churches, but now they had appeared en masse in the perilous maze mines. It was hard to imagine they had made their way here step by step. If not, were they born in the maze?
EnemyData_Description_41004: The monsters that wander the mines often burrow underground, using the tunnels they create to dig up small gems or play pranks. How do they travel so quickly underground without using tools? Perhaps this is their own magical secret, but it seems they know how Mr. Alto transports construction materials.
EnemyData_Description_42001: A powerful monster that haunts gems, guarding all the gems in its territory. To it, gems are both treasure and weapons. Adventurers who encounter the Exploding Pangolin will report to the Adventurer's Guild that it can fire gem bombs. Despite this danger, they still prioritize subjugating the Exploding Pangolin, after all, the gems on its body are worth far more than the commission's reward.
EnemyData_Description_42002: One of the oldest monsters in the mines, thousands of years of surviving challenges have endowed them with exceptional combat prowess. Constantly absorbing the magical energy emanating from the magic ore has given them energy levels comparable to those of magic apprentices. To adapt to the mine's harsh environment, they gnaw on rocks for nutrition, absorb magic ore to enhance their strength, and successfully evolve. Monster evolution requires luck, and the Crystal Scorpion has no shortage of it.
EnemyData_Description_43001: A powerful lord guarding the mines, a magical golem from an unknown era, possesses the power to destroy mountains once activated. Magic golems are frequently used in wars. These golems are powerful, loyal, brave, and incapable of fear. Their thirst for victory has led to rapid advancements in magic golem technology, culminating in the creation of a Titan that can easily destroy a castle. With the war's end, the golems were abandoned, gradually blending seamlessly into their surroundings, becoming part of the historical relic. However, the "core" that powered the Titan remains healthy. Rather than abandoned, it awaits the next war, the next battlefield...
EnemyData_Description_51001: Even out of water, this ordinary monster, capable of firing dark magic missiles, retains its powerful vitality. This octopus monster requires constant nourishment to maintain its health, perhaps a small price to pay for surviving out of water.
EnemyData_Description_52001: The fused sub-beast was suppressed by three totems in the mountain forest temple. The temple seemed peaceful, but the three totems were emitting magical power all the time, and travelers who had seen the totems would be haunted by nightmares. Perhaps the real source of power of these totems came from the resentment of the Chimera who had been trapped in the temple for hundreds of years.
EnemyData_Description_52002: Legend has it that such creatures lurk in the garden ponds of the Sky City, ready to attack uninvited visitors who attempt to enter and seize its treasures. Although no one has ever been able to enter the Sky City, or even see these aquatic creatures, their mere mention has spread throughout the land. Several sages who have visited the Sky City have said, "They are gentle and pure, but precisely because of this, they become ferocious and violent when polluted."
EnemyData_Description_52003:
A black-robed being of suffering, the most dangerous being in the maze.
It wasn't born within the maze from the very beginning, but rather emerged from its depths, absorbing power from beyond.
Adventurers' explorations always involve casualties, and the Grim Reaper draws life from these casualties, and strength from suffering. Those who encounter the Messenger of Death don't know if it possesses self-awareness, but one thing is clear: someone must pay the price...
EnemyData_Description_53001: The powerful lord guarding the Forbidden Lands, a noble ancient dragon known only in storybooks, the oldest and most powerful creature on the continent. Though rarely seen, it remains the most threatening enemy to kingdoms and the Adventurer's Guild. The Adventurer's Guild maintains few records of the ancient dragons, but the story of the Chaos Dragon is told in the bard's storybooks: [O great being that sleeps within the spirit veins... please hear my wish, cast away all your inner anxiety, and rest in the embrace of nature.] [Goddess Tina gently strokes the Chaos Dragon's forehead, then sings a ballad before disappearing beside the ancient dragon. From then on, the ancient dragon ceases its tormented slumber and soars high in the sky, returning to its spirit veins only to rest when a rainbow appears in the sky...]

GuideData_TailText_1:
Tap the normal attack button to unleash a series of attacks that deal damage to the enemy. |
Tap the normal attack button while dodging to unleash a dodge attack. |
Press and hold the normal attack button to unleash a normal heavy attack. |
When the heavy attack energy is full, hold the attack button for an even more powerful heavy attack. |
Tap the skill button to unleash a skill unique to that character, which enters a cooldown period. |
When the burst skill meter is full, tap the burst skill button to unleash a powerful skill unique to that character, which clears the burst skill meter.
GuideData_TailText_10:
The maze is filled with various traps. Offensive traps can damage characters or monsters. |
Curse traps can inflict various abnormal status effects on characters or monsters.
GuideData_TailText_101: After providing materials to the camp engineer Alto, he can rebuild various buildings in the adventure camp for you and unlock more functions.
GuideData_TailText_102: The Guild Support Table can consume various materials to activate various auxiliary functions that help players in their adventures.
GuideData_TailText_103: Each adventure partner has his or her own recruitment conditions. Once met, you can consume the recruitment certificate to unlock a new character.
GuideData_TailText_104: Each character has several weapons of different styles and abilities. After meeting the unlocking conditions, you can consume ore materials to craft weapons.
GuideData_TailText_105: After unlocking a weapon, you can consume more ore materials to upgrade the weapon to gain greater power.
GuideData_TailText_106: The adventure commission column is managed by the guild commission administrator Lottie. Players can complete the tasks in the commission to obtain rewards.
GuideData_TailText_107: Consuming bounty letters allows you to accept some bounty commissions, and you can get many valuable rewards after completing them.
GuideData_TailText_108:
The Relic Guide lists all relics found in the dungeon. |
Players can spend Wishing Points to select an unlocked relic to increase its chance of appearing.
GuideData_TailText_109:
The Monster Altar records all monsters encountered in the dungeon. The spirits of these monsters await your summoning at the dungeon's Monster Altar. |

By consuming materials to strengthen these monsters, players gain global stat bonuses.
GuideData_TailText_11:
Deals 15% of your attack damage + 10 damage per second for 5 seconds. |
Reduces damage dealt by 5%, stacks up to 5 times, lasts 4 seconds. |
Reduces movement speed by 20%, increases damage taken by 10%, lasts 5 seconds. |

Reduces attack damage by 20%, lasts 10 seconds. |
While holding a mark, you will take critical damage if your health drops below 20%. The mark lasts for 3 seconds.
GuideData_TailText_110: Interact with the Rune Stone and use its power to allow monsters to explore other places and harvest some materials.
GuideData_TailText_111: Some recipes require meeting unlocking conditions before they can be discovered. After discovering the recipe, you need to consume materials to unlock it.
GuideData_TailText_112: At the entrance to each maze, players can consume materials to cook unlocked recipes to obtain special effects to assist the adventure.
GuideData_TailText_113: Mazes have multiple difficulty tiers. Clearing the current tier unlocks the next. As difficulty increases, enemies gain various enhancements.|Higher difficulties yield richer adventure rewards.
GuideData_TailText_115: Stronghold decorations unlock after every building reaches its maximum level. Select a building, choose a decoration, and press Confirm to apply it.
GuideData_TailText_12:
Increases critical strike chance by 2% and critical strike damage by 3% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.|
Enters Super Armor and increases defense by 50% for 10 seconds.丨

GuideData_TailText_13:
When a monster's health drops to 10%, it ignores damage for 2 seconds and gradually heals 40% of its maximum health.|

Gives armor equal to 100% of its health. If the monster's current armor is not 0, it regenerates 1% armor every second.|

When a monster's health drops below 50%, it gains 30% movement speed and attacks more frequently.|

When a monster is in Corrosion mode, being attacked has a 20% chance to inflict a 3-second healing barrier on the attacker.|

The monster heals 15% of its health every 5 seconds for nearby allies (excluding itself).|

The monster is in Super Armor mode and is 50% immune to damage while attacking.|

The first damage dealt is doubled.|

1 health point is lost per second for 5 seconds.|

The monster heals 3% of its health with each attack.|

The monster gains a 30% attack damage bonus and 30% armor penetration.|

Gains a damage reduction effect, weakening the monster after being attacked.|
GuideData_TailText_14: Elite enemies have armor equal to 100% of their maximum health. The armor can absorb damage instead of health, and their resistance to interruption is greatly improved when holding the armor.
GuideData_TailText_2:
Each character has a unique level, divided into Bronze, Iron, Mithril, Gold, and Platinum. Each level increase increases their health, attack power, and defense. |
As your Adventurer Rating increases, your character will unlock more talents for your adventures!
GuideData_TailText_201: The treasures in the maze are divided into ordinary wooden treasure chests, exquisite iron treasure chests, gorgeous gold treasure chests, and lord treasure chests. The higher the level of the treasure chest, the more precious the rewards dropped and the more difficult it is to obtain.
GuideData_TailText_202:
Some rooms will have a proliferation symbol, indicating a significantly increased chance of containing the materials or items marked with the symbol. |
The consumed Seal light point can be moved vertically to the marked location.
GuideData_TailText_203:
The entrance to the maze area. Players can rest at this node or interact with items. |
Nodes lurking with common monsters are believed to contain treasure. |
Intelligence indicates that this node contains powerful elite monsters. Defeating these monsters will reveal even rarer treasures. |
The Maze Merchant and his carriage appear at safe nodes throughout the maze, selling maze relics. |
This node contains a sacred spring that heals injuries, and the mysterious Slime King also frequently appears here. |
The trap rooms generated within the maze are impossible to dodge continuously in this node. Behind the traps lies a rare treasure. |
The maze's guard monsters are extremely powerful, and only by defeating them can you advance deeper into the maze.
GuideData_TailText_204:
Some nodes contain destructible barriers that block ranged attacks and movement and can be destroyed. |
Each level of the maze contains regional materials, which have a chance to appear at each node and need to be collected by attacking. |
Nodes have a chance to contain gold or mana veins; destroying them will collect some of these materials.
GuideData_TailText_3:
Within the maze, players can obtain special items to aid in exploration by obtaining Relic Bags and other methods. These items are only effective during that exploration. |

Each relic typically has its own rank. Higher star ratings increase the power and difficulty of obtaining it. |

Some relics have their own series. Collecting all of them will activate a more powerful relic.
GuideData_TailText_4:
Mysterious altars that hatch Pokémon eggs will randomly appear in the maze. When not in combat, players can interact with them to gain the power of an elemental Pokémon, valid only for this particular adventure. |

When interacting with a Pokémon altar, if you already possess a Pokémon, there's a chance you'll be able to select an upgrade state for that Pokémon, increasing its power. The highest level for each Pokémon is five-star. |

Once you've met the unlocking requirements and collected two five-star Pokémon of matching power, opening the Pokémon altar again will reveal the most powerful Pokémon fusion form!
GuideData_TailText_5: After selecting some special talents, you can immediately release a special attack by releasing a normal attack, combat skill or heavy attack according to the talent description and then tapping the normal attack button.
GuideData_TailText_6:
Players can equip special tokens given by characters in their Token List to gain additional adventure support. |
Giving gifts to other companions can increase their favorability and may even earn them a gift in return.
GuideData_TailText_7:
Players can obtain cursed relics at the Cursed Altar. These relics can restrict the player's combat power or strengthen other monsters. Once the purification conditions are met, these relics will return to their original form. |
Completing the purification conditions for a cursed relic will yield a Purified Relic, which is often more powerful than a normal relic.
GuideData_TailText_8:
Armor absorbs damage in lieu of health, and even if armor shatters due to excessive damage, health is not lost. |
While the shield is active, it provides immunity to all incoming damage.
GuideData_TailText_9:
Interacting with the Monster Altar in a node grants the power of monster souls. When you have enough support energy, you can summon monsters to aid you in battle. |
Players can select a monster support skill equipment item, and can possess up to two different monster support skills. |
Monster Support Altars can select exclusive relics, which can be used to enhance monster support skills or grant powerful buffs to players after using them. |
After selecting a monster support skill, attack monsters to increase support energy. When fully charged, you gain 1 support energy point, which you can then spend to summon the monster support skill.

MaterialData_Description_101:
The kingdom's universal currency for thousands of years, and in some sense the root of all evil.
How to obtain: Defeat monsters or open treasure chests to collect.
MaterialData_Description_10101:
A special plant that grows only in the Magic Forest, woven from magical threads. It seems to consciously observe everything around it and record it in its maze memory.
How to obtain: Gather in the Magic Forest area.
MaterialData_Description_10102:
A special plant that grows only in the Magic Forest. Its tear-like fruits hang down and emit a faint glow, guiding travelers along the way or providing rest for the weary.
How to obtain: Gather in the Magic Forest area.
MaterialData_Description_102:
This crystallization of magical energy exists only within the maze. Although it cannot be used, it can be valuable in the hands of some people.
How to obtain: Defeat monsters or open treasure chests to collect.
MaterialData_Description_10201:
This unique plant, which grows only in desert Gobi, constantly absorbs heat from the ground and releases burning magic around it. Its everlasting flame and petals complement each other.
How to obtain: Gather in desert Gobi areas.
MaterialData_Description_10202:
These unique plants, which only grow in deserts and Gobi, use their powerful magical affinity to wrap themselves in windblown sand and rock fragments, thus surviving for tens of millions of years.
How to obtain: Gather in deserts and Gobi areas.
MaterialData_Description_103:
Crystals imbued with magical energy are crucial magical ingredients used by master blacksmiths to craft weapons. Their extremely difficult mining conditions guarantee their immense value. Considering their special use for weapons, some might even seek revenge against their possessors.
How to Obtain: Defeat the Lord and unlock the Lord's Treasure Chest to collect.
How to Use: Consume them at the Blacksmith's Shop to unlock or upgrade weapons.
MaterialData_Description_10301:
A special plant that grows only in the mountain snowfields. Its petals fall to reveal an icy blue fruit. Even after you pluck the fruit, you can still feel the cool air radiating from it in your palm like a breath.
How to obtain: Gather in the mountain snowfield area.
MaterialData_Description_10302:
A special plant that grows only in mountain snowfields. Unlike other cold-resistant plants, this fungus exudes warmth, shielding it from the wind and snow as if protecting something, time and again.
How to Obtain: Gather in the Mountain Snowfield area.
MaterialData_Description_10401:
This special ore, grown only in underground mines, is a mysterious ore formed by magical runes that gather scattered mineral dust. Its interior emits a faint fluorescence, appearing to flicker with life.
How to Obtain: Gather in the underground mine area.
MaterialData_Description_10402:
This special ore, grown only in underground mines, has grown from the earth's veins over countless ages. This precious crystal, imbued with powerful magical energy, symbolizes the history of the entire Labyrinth Era.
How to Obtain: Gather in the underground mine area.
MaterialData_Description_10501:
A fragile flower growing from the chaotic space, it is so weak that it will turn to ash and perish if stepped on; yet it is so powerful that it can become the bud that creates a new world.
How to obtain: Gather in the Demon Gathering Land.
MaterialData_Description_106:
Only those who have ventured into adventure can truly understand the true value of the Golden Apple in the maze.
How to Obtain: After repairing the Adventurer's Guild, there's a chance you can collect it in the maze.
How to Use: Give it to others during conversation to increase their favorability.
MaterialData_Description_107:
The source of monsters' power, possessing extremely high alchemical value, some can even use it to resonate with monsters.
How to obtain: Defeat the lord and open the lord's treasure chest to collect.
How to use: After rebuilding the "Monster Altar", consume it at the Monster Altar in the camp to increase monster levels and enhance its own attributes.
MaterialData_Description_40001:
A message from an outsider, often from a high-ranking position. While the requirements are high, the rewards are generous.
Obtaining: Obtained from Guild Support Boxes or monster tasks.
Using: After recreating "Bounty Commission," use it in the Bounty Commission column to accept bounty missions.
MaterialData_Description_40101: Being a high-level adventurer is a privilege that allows you to skip all obstacles and be the first to receive rewards.
MaterialData_Description_501:
Adventurers record their experiences in the guild after their adventures. Sufficient records can be used to increase their Adventurer Rating.
Obtain: Obtained by completing commissions or monster tasks.
Use: Consume in the character profile to quickly increase your Adventurer Rating.
MaterialData_Description_502:
This certificate is used to recruit adventurers. Only those recognized by the guild and other adventurers are eligible to obtain it.
How to obtain: Obtained in the Maze Mall.
How to use: Use it in Team Management to unlock new adventure partners.
MaterialData_Description_802: You can get some rare items
MaterialData_Description_90002:
A mysterious crystal emitting a rainbow of light, people believe it must be a blessing from the highest heaven.
How to obtain: Defeat the lord and open the lord's treasure chest to collect.
How to use: Purchase a gift pack in the mall or open a fun treasure chest.
MonsterWorkData_Description_101:
A group of bandits has set up camp near the maze adventurer camp and is collecting unreasonable tolls.
Although Miss Lottie of the Adventurer's Guild often punishes them, some always slip through the net. Now it's time to make these guys pay the price.
MonsterWorkData_Description_102:
The Hungry Woods in the Enchanted Forest lure animals or travelers to rest near them, then prepare to hunt them.
Now that your monsters have discovered these terrifying woods, it's time to let them wreak havoc.
MonsterWorkData_Description_103:
Some witches hide themselves in the woods and swamps to conduct strange research.
Interestingly, there are always many precious materials thrown out like garbage around these witches' huts. It should be okay to send monsters to pick some up.
MonsterWorkData_Description_104:
There are an incredible number of temples in the desert, but the treasures within them are only accessible to monsters.
In that case, let's go and bring back some gifts.
MonsterWorkData_Description_105:
The Desert Lizard Tribe is holding a sacrifice, and your monsters have seen the maze materials and looted treasures on the altar.
While the lizards are resting, have the monsters take back the items that belonged to the adventurers.
MonsterWorkData_Description_106: It's not just adventurers who make a fortune in the maze. Unscrupulous nobles often charge exorbitant tolls to passing merchants. A mysterious merchant has commissioned you to teach these nobles a lesson, and he'll pay you handsomely.
MonsterWorkData_Description_107:
Many adventurers like to record their adventures in diaries, waiting for the right people to learn about their legendary lives.
Some diaries may be boring, but the adventure skills they contain may become your most powerful helper.
MonsterWorkData_Description_108: Mountains covered in snow year-round are always rich in magical energy. Such an environment will surely produce better maze materials, so letting monsters that are not afraid of wind and snow explore there should be a good choice.
MonsterWorkData_Description_109:
Adventurers once took refuge in a snowy mountain cave and discovered a wealth of maze materials.
It's clear this place is worth a visit, and your monster companions are ready to go.
MonsterWorkData_Description_110:
Lord Finch possesses immense power and inestimable wealth, but unfortunately, his treasures can only remain with him in the tomb.
Monsters are always curious about mazes and tombs, and finding some treasures inside and bringing them back would be a great opportunity.
MonsterWorkData_Description_111: Ever since the dwarves were defeated by the orcs on the battlefield, they've abandoned this underground city, which holds a wealth of resources. So sending monsters to gather some would be a good idea.
MonsterWorkData_Description_112:
An escape has occurred from the kingdom's underground prison.
The monsters investigated the whereabouts of these criminals and happened to bring you a bounty commission from the Adventurer's Guild.
MonsterWorkData_Description_113: Let your monsters fight against the maze lord and let them learn more powerful fighting skills.
MonsterWorkData_Description_114: A garden treasury once filled with the treasures of the maze, now only ruins and fragments of relics remain. Perhaps only monsters could find anything valuable here.
MonsterWorkData_Description_115:
A huge lake formed by liquefied magic, and near it grows the most valuable maze materials.
While the maze remains unchanged, send monsters to collect some materials.
MonsterWorkData_Description_116:
The maze seals memories in a library built of stone bricks, which records the exploration information of all adventurers.
No one has ever recorded history or taken care of books here, but the books do appear here, even if the previous record is that your monster is searching for the memory corridor.
MonsterWorkData_Description_117:
A huge tower stands in the maze, a mysterious place that no one has ever found.
No one could have imagined that this unattended tower is hiding an inexhaustible supply of colorful crystals.
